feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: A family runs afoul of the Russian mob in the terrific 'Paper Tiger'
entry.summary: Adam Driver, Scarlett Johansson and Miles Teller star in a film that isn't merely one of this year's very best films; it possesses a weight and depth you rarely find in American movies anymore.

entry.title: Robert Pattinson is the next James Bond
entry.summary: "We were surrounded by extraordinary talent, but there can only be one 007," Denis Villeneuve, who will direct the new Bond film, said in an announcement from Amazon MGM Studios.

entry.title: Lindsay Clancy to face a new trial in spring of 2027 over children's killing
entry.summary: A new trial is set in Massachusetts against Lindsay Clancy as prosecutors seek a criminal conviction over the killing of her three young children.

entry.title: RAYE and Rosalía lead the 2027 Grammy nominations
entry.summary: The nominations for the 69th annual Grammy Awards were announced on Monday, and women artists across genres rule the major categories.

entry.title: Chris Van Hollen says he can beat Chuck Schumer. Here's his case
entry.summary: Sen. Chris Van Hollen told NPR's Morning Edition why he believes he can defeat Sen. Chuck Schumer and what he would change about Senate Democratic leadership.

entry.title: These birds fly 17,000 miles every year. Climate change could make it harder
entry.summary: Migratory birds cross the entire globe, carefully timing their journeys with the seasons. In a hotter climate, that timing is increasingly out of sync.

entry.title: NPR's Student Podcast Challenge is back for 2027
entry.summary: The annual audio competition for grades four through 12 returns in January. Now in its ninth year, the contest has involved more than 90,000 students around the country.

entry.title: They saw people losing food benefits. So they started handing out free groceries
entry.summary: The cuts and changes to SNAP have been difficult for government workers who take pride in helping others. In San Diego, workers said they couldn't sit back while their neighbors went hungry.

entry.title: Trump heads to Asia to meet with Xi and Putin amid Nvidia fallout
entry.summary: The trip to China marks Trump's second time this year, and comes as the president and his party faced widespread backlash from voters in the recent midterm elections.

entry.title: Why sleep matters when it comes to weight gain and loss
entry.summary: Sleep can have a powerful impact on weight. Research shows it can affect appetite. There is also a two-way relationship between sleep quality and diet.
